name: Trapezoidal LR
tagline: Linear warmup, constant plateau, then linear cooldown over the last 40% of steps.
formula: $$\eta(t) = \begin{cases} \eta_{\max}\frac{t+1}{W+1}, & t < W \\ \eta_{\max}, & W \le t < 0.6\,T \\ \eta_{\min} + (\eta_{\max}-\eta_{\min})\!\left(1-\tfrac{t-0.6T}{0.4T}\right), & 0.6T \le t \le T \\ \eta_{\min}, & t > T \end{cases}$$

key_hyperparams.name: cooldown frac
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of training spent in linear decay

diff_from_baseline: Hu et al. 2024 (MiniCPM warmup-stable-decay). Simple alternative to cosine annealing with explicit plateau and cooldown phases; works well at small to medium scale.

name: WSD
tagline: Three-phase WSD schedule: linear warmup, long constant, linear decay over the last 20% of training.
diff_from_baseline: Hu et al. 2024 (MiniCPM). Default Warmup-Stable-Decay: a long stable phase enables checkpoint reuse for downstream finetuning; standard alternative to cosine schedules in modern LLM pretraining.

name: WSD + sqrt decay
tagline: WSD with extended 6% warmup and inverse-square-root cooldown over the last 20% (gentler than linear).
diff_from_baseline: Hu et al. 2024 (MiniCPM) with inverse-sqrt decay variant (e.g., Hagele et al. 2024). Replaces linear cooldown with a smoother $1/\sqrt{\cdot}$ profile shown to preserve more learning signal at end of training.
